description: FM Moneyball exports omit advanced metrics for some leagues. Those columns export as 0 rather than blank. FMScouter detects this pattern and excludes the affected metrics from percentile averages.

detection.summary: A division is limited-tracking when minutes-weighted averages of advanced probe /90 rates across all players with minutes are near zero (max avg ≤ 0.25) and the division has ≥300 total minutes. Sparse leftovers (transfers, continental) do not veto the league; zero-minute rows do not affect aggregates. Probes are metrics absent in limited leagues (interceptions, key passes, progressive passes, clearances) — not xA / possession won. Recorded as limited_tracking_divisions on the upload index for striped Division highlights.

universal_metrics.summary: Tracked in all leagues that provide any match stats in the export (always scored when present). Includes xA and possession won, which FM still fills for limited-data leagues.

limited_tracking_unavailable.summary: Absent in limited-tracking leagues; excluded from percentile averages when all advanced probes are zero.
